info.cls_ename: RMIT-FCU 2+2 Bachelor's Program in Business and Innovation

description.describe_ch: This course aims at helping students who are planning to pursue undergraduate studies oversea. It develops students applied academic writing skills. The teaching unit include a full process of compiling an individual research project—poetic autoethnography—which students need to work on identifying research questions, locating academic sources, correcting data, discussing data to answer their research questions, and making oral presentations

textBooks.tpb_book:
Publication Manual of the American Psychological Association: The Official Guide to APA Style
-Used for practice writing a ~1500 word research paper on the topic of students choosing
Graff, G., & Birkenstein, C. (2021). "They say / i say" : the moves that matter in academic writing (Fifth). W.W. Norton & Company.
-Recommended resource for academic writing practice

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en:

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂規則
1. Students are expected to arrive to class on time.
2. Students are encouraged to bring a laptop computer or tablet with which to do in-class assignments. 
3. Assignments must be turned in on time. The teacher reserves the right to not accept any late assignments. 
4. Two absences or less will not affect student grades. Students are responsible for communication and arrangements for additional absences.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Course Policies
Students are expected to show up on time and ready to work. Students are strongly encouraged to bring a laptop to class, though a tablet with keyboard will work in a pinch.  Assignments will be accepted late at a penalty of 20%. Assignments will not be accepted more than two weeks after the original due date except in the case of truly extenuating circumstances.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
LLMs can be an excellent tool to aid you in your journey as a writer. At present, they cannot replace humans, and misuse or overuse of this tool will only be denying yourself a learning opportunity.
Plagiarism is unacceptable.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: Students are expected to complete their work on time and by themselves. Appropriate use of outside learning aids (Grammarly, ChatGPT, other LLMs) is acceptable under certain circumstances outlined in class. Assignments found to be plagiarized will result in a 0. To avoid plagiarism, follow the APA citation guidelines as taught during this course.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en: Students are expected to complete all of their own work and provide citations as needed (no restriction on formatting). Violations of academic integrity will be judged on a case-by-case basis. A first violation will generally result in a 0 on the assignment, a second violation with a harsher penalty, and a third violation will generally result in a 0 in the course.
